pages.title: Day 30: The Ultimate Encounter

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Gideon was hiding. He was threshing wheat in a winepress so his enemies would not see him. He was the least important person in his family. He was scared. And an angel appeared to him and said something ridiculous. "The Lord is with you, mighty warrior."


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to keep it from the Midianites. The angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, 'The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.'" - Judges 6:11-12


Gideon was a nobody. He was hiding. He was scared. And the angel called him a mighty warrior. That is a joke. Or it would be. But it is not. Because the angel is not looking at who Gideon is. He is looking at who Gideon will become. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He shows up to the weak. He calls them what they are not. He makes them what they cannot be.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


God chooses the weak. He chose Gideon. He chose the foolish. He chose the weak. He chose the ones the world would throw away. The angel under the oak is a shadow. The Christ who calls the weak is the substance. He calls you. He calls you a warrior. He calls you strong. He calls you His.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He calls the weak. He makes them strong. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel like the least? Like the smallest? Like the one nobody would pick? The angel called a scared man a mighty warrior. God sees what you can become. He is not put off by your fear. He comes near to you. He calls you by a new name. Listen. He is calling.


The Prayer


God, you call me what I cannot see yet. You called a scared man a mighty warrior. Thank you that you come to the weak. Make me brave. You are with me. I am a warrior. I am strong. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Angel to Gideon

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


A woman could not have children. She was barren. And an angel appeared to her. He told her she would have a son. A special son. A son who would save. The son was Samson. But the pattern is deeper. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to the barren. He gives the impossible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The angel of the LORD appeared to her and said, 'You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.'" - Judges 13:3


The angel came to a barren woman. He promised a son. The son would be special. The son would save. This is a picture. It is a picture of the birth of Jesus. The angel came to Mary. He promised a son. The son would save. The angel to Samson's mother is a shadow. The angel to Mary is the substance. The promise is the same. The God is the same. The pre-incarnate Christ comes to the barren. He gives the impossible.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He promised a son. The son was Jesus. The angel to Samson's mother is a shadow. The angel to Mary is the substance. The impossible is possible. The barren becomes fruitful. The child is given. The Son is given. The God comes.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He comes to the barren. He gives the impossible. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you have a barren place? A place where nothing grows? A place where nothing lives? God comes to the barren. He gives the impossible. He gives a son. He gives a child. He gives a future. He is not limited by your barrenness. He is the God of the impossible. He comes to you.


The Prayer


God, I have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. Come to me. Give me the impossible. Give me a future. Give me a hope. You are the God of the impossible. You come to the barren. I am waiting. I am trusting. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Angel to Samson's Parents

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Zechariah was a priest. He was old. His wife was old. They had no children. They had prayed for years. They had given up. And an angel appeared to him in the temple. He was terrified. And the angel told him his prayer had been heard. His wife would have a son. The son would be John. The forerunner. This is one of the most powerful encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.'" - Luke 1:13


The angel came to Zechariah. In the temple. He heard his prayer. The prayer he had given up on. The prayer he had stopped believing. The angel said, "Your prayer has been heard." This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to the praying. He comes to the waiting. He comes to the old. He comes to the barren. He hears. He answers. He gives. The prayer is heard. The son is given. The forerunner is coming.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him." - Luke 1:76


John was the forerunner. He prepared the way. He came before Jesus. The angel came to Zechariah. He promised John. John prepared the way. The angel to Zechariah is a shadow. The John who prepares the way is the substance. The one who comes is Jesus. The one who prepares is John. The God is the same.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He hears. He answers. He gives. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Have you given up on a prayer? Have you stopped praying? Have you lost hope? The angel heard Zechariah's prayer. God hears yours. He has not forgotten. He has not given up. He is answering. Even now. Even in the waiting. Your prayer has been heard. Keep praying. Keep believing. He is coming.


The Prayer


God, I have given up on some prayers. I have stopped believing. But you hear. You answer. You give. Thank you. Thank you that my prayer is heard. Thank you that you have not forgotten. I am praying again. I am believing again. I am trusting again. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Angel to Zechariah

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Joseph was a carpenter. He was engaged to Mary. She was pregnant. Not by him. He was going to divorce her. Quietly. To save her from shame. But an angel appeared to him in a dream. And told him not to be afraid. The child was from God. The child was the Savior. The child was Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.'" - Matthew 1:20


The angel came to Joseph. In a dream. He told him the child was from God. The child was the Savior. The child was Jesus. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to the scared. He comes to the confused. He comes to the ones who do not understand. He speaks. He calms. He guides. Joseph obeyed. He took Mary home. The child was born. The Savior came.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21


The name is Jesus. He saves. The angel to Joseph is a shadow. The Jesus who saves is the substance. The child is the Savior. The name is the name. The salvation is the salvation. The God is the God. He comes to the confused. He speaks. He saves.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He speaks. He guides. He saves. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you confused? Are you scared? Are you unsure of what to do? The angel came to Joseph. He spoke. He guided. He calmed. God speaks to you. He guides you. He calms you. Do not be afraid. The child is from God. The Savior is here. Trust Him.


The Prayer


God, I am confused. I am scared. I am unsure. Speak to me. Guide me. Calm me. Do not let me be afraid. You are here. You are with me. You are the Savior. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Angel to Joseph

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Shepherds were in the fields. They were watching their sheep. It was night. It was quiet. And then the sky lit up. An angel appeared. They were terrified. And the angel said, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy." The good news was the birth of Jesus. This is one of the most famous encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"But the angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.'" - Luke 2:10-11


The angel came to the shepherds. The lowest of the low. The ones nobody noticed. The ones nobody invited. And the angel brought them the good news. The Savior was born. The Messiah was here. The Lord was in a manger. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to the overlooked. He comes to the forgotten. He comes to the ones nobody else would visit. He brings good news. He brings joy. He brings the Savior.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord." - Luke 2:11


The Savior is born. The Messiah is here. The Lord is in the manger. The angel to the shepherds is a shadow. The birth of Jesus is the substance. The good news is the reality. The joy is the reality. The Savior is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He comes to the overlooked. He brings good news. He brings joy. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel overlooked? Do you feel forgotten? Do you feel like nobody notices you? The angel came to the shepherds. God comes to you. You are not forgotten. You are not overlooked. He has good news for you. He has joy for you. He has a Savior for you. Listen. The good news is for you.


The Prayer


God, I feel overlooked. I feel forgotten. But you came to the shepherds. You come to me. Thank you for the good news. Thank you for the joy. Thank you for the Savior. I am not forgotten. I am not overlooked. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Angel to the Shepherds

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Isaiah was in the temple. He was worshiping. He was a prophet. He was a man of God. But then he saw something. He saw the Lord. High and lifted up. On a throne. The train of His robe filled the temple. Angels were flying. They were calling. "Holy, holy, holy." And Isaiah was undone. He saw God. And he saw himself.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple." - Isaiah 6:1


Isaiah saw the Lord. On the throne. High and lifted up. In the temple. The angels were flying. The seraphim were calling. "Holy, holy, holy." This is the pre-incarnate Christ. Isaiah saw Him. John tells us that Isaiah saw His glory. He saw Jesus. On the throne. High and lifted up. He saw the King. He saw the Lord. He saw the Holy One.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him." - John 12:41


Isaiah saw Jesus. He saw His glory. He saw His throne. He saw His holiness. The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The glory is the reality. The throne is the reality. The Holy One is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The glory is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you need to see the Lord? Do you need to see His glory? Do you need to see His holiness? Look at Jesus. He is on the throne. He is high and lifted up. He is holy. He is the King. Bow down. Worship. He is here. He is the Lord. He is the Holy One.


The Prayer


Lord, I see you. High and lifted up. Holy. On the throne. I am undone. I am unclean. But you are holy. You are the King. Touch my lips with the coal. Cleanse me. Send me. I worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: The Angel in the Temple

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Ezekiel was in exile. He was by a river. He was with the other exiles. And he saw a vision. A storm. A cloud. A fire. And four creatures. And wheels. Wheels within wheels. Full of eyes. Moving in every direction. And above the wheels was a throne. And on the throne was a figure. Like a man. This is one of the strangest and most powerful encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"As I looked, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces. This was the appearance of the wheels and their construction: they sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel." - Ezekiel 1:15-16


The wheels. Within wheels. Full of eyes. Moving in every direction. And above them. A throne. And on the throne. A figure. Like a man. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He is on the throne. Above the wheels. Above the creatures. Above the storm. He is the one who rules. He is the one who moves. He is the one who sees. He is the Lord. He is the King.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Then I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands, and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest." - Revelation 1:12-13


John saw the Son of Man. Among the lampstands. In the glory. On the throne. Ezekiel saw the same. The throne. The figure. The glory. The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The throne is the reality. The King is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The throne is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel like God is far away? Do you feel like the world is out of control? Look at the vision. Look at the throne. Look at the wheels. God is on the throne. He is in control. He sees. He moves. He rules. Nothing is out of His control. Nothing is outside His sight. He is on the throne. Trust Him.


The Prayer


God, I feel like the world is out of control. I feel like you are far away. But you are on the throne. You are in control. You see. You move. You rule. I trust you. I worship you. You are the King. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Wheel Within a Wheel

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Ezekiel saw a vision. A man. Dressed in linen. With a writing kit at his side. He was sent to mark the foreheads of the faithful. He was sent to protect them. He was sent to save them. This is one of the most important encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"While I was watching, the six men arrived from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side." - Ezekiel 9:2


The man in linen. With a writing kit. He was sent to mark the faithful. He was sent to protect them. He was sent to save them. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to mark His people. He comes to protect them. He comes to save them. He is the one with the writing kit. He is the one with the mark. He is the one who seals. He is the one who saves.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God." - Revelation 7:3


The seal. On the foreheads. The mark. Of the faithful. The man in linen is a shadow. The Christ with the seal is the substance. The mark is the reality. The protection is the reality. The salvation is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The man in linen is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He marks. He protects. He saves. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you want to be marked? Do you want to be protected? Do you want to be saved? The man in linen marked the faithful. Jesus marks His own. He seals them. He protects them. He saves them. You can be marked. You can be sealed. You can be saved. Come to Him. He will mark you. He will protect you. He will save you.


The Prayer


Jesus, mark me. Seal me. Protect me. Save me. I want to be yours. I want to be marked. I want to be sealed. I want to be saved. Thank you. Thank you for the mark. Thank you for the seal. Thank you for the salvation. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Man with the Writing Kit

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


Balaam was a prophet. He was hired to curse God's people. But he could not. He blessed them instead. And he spoke a prophecy. He said, "A star will come out of Jacob." A star. Out of Jacob. This is one of the most important prophecies in the Bible. And it points to Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel." - Numbers 24:17


A star. Out of Jacob. A scepter. Out of Israel. This is a prophecy. It is a promise. It is a picture. The star is the pre-incarnate Christ. He is the one who would come. He is the one who would rise. He is the one who would shine. The star is the sign. The scepter is the rule. The King is the one. The prophecy is a shadow. The star of Bethlehem is the substance. The star is Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem and asked, 'Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.'" - Matthew 2:1-2


The Magi saw the star. They followed it. They found Jesus. They worshiped Him. The star is a shadow. The birth of Jesus is the substance. The King is the reality. The star led them to Him. The prophecy led us to Him. The star is Jesus. The King is Jesus. The one we worship is Jesus.


The Verdict


The star is a shadow. The King is the substance. He shines. He rules. He saves. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you looking for a sign? Are you looking for a star? Are you looking for something to follow? The star led the Magi to Jesus. The sign points to the King. Follow the star. Follow the sign. Follow Jesus. He is the one you are looking for. He is the one who shines. He is the one who saves.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the star. You are the King. You are the one I am looking for. I follow you. I worship you. I love you. Thank you for the star. Thank you for the sign. Thank you for the King. I am here. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Star of Bethlehem

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook


The women came to the tomb. They came to anoint the body of Jesus. They came with spices. They came with grief. They came with loss. And when they got there, the stone was rolled away. The tomb was empty. And an angel was sitting there. And the angel spoke. And the angel changed everything.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The angel said to the women, 'Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.'" - Matthew 28:5-6


The angel spoke to the women. He told them not to be afraid. He told them Jesus was not there. He told them Jesus had risen. He told them to come and see. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He is the risen Lord. He is the one who speaks. He is the one who calms. He is the one who sends. The angel is a shadow. The risen Jesus is the substance. He is not here. He has risen.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay." - Matthew 28:6


The tomb is empty. The Lord has risen. The angel spoke. The women saw. The world changed. The angel at the tomb is a shadow. The risen Jesus is the substance. The empty tomb is the reality. The resurrection is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The risen Jesus is the substance. The tomb is empty. The Lord has risen. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you looking for Jesus? Are you looking for the living among the dead? He is not here. He has risen. He is alive. He is not in the tomb. He is not in the grave. He is with you. He is with us. He is the risen Lord. Look for Him among the living. He is here.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are not here. You have risen. You are alive. You are the risen Lord. Thank you. Thank you for the empty tomb. Thank you for the resurrection. Thank you for the life. I am looking for you. I am finding you. You are here. You are alive. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook


John was on the island of Patmos. He was in exile. He was alone. He was worshiping on the Lord's Day. And he heard a voice. A loud voice. Like a trumpet. And he turned. And he saw seven golden lampstands. And among them was someone like a son of man. And John fell at His feet as though dead. This is one of the most powerful encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: 'Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.'" - Revelation 1:17


John saw the Son of Man. In the glory. Among the lampstands. He fell at His feet. He was overwhelmed. He was undone. And the Son of Man touched him. And said, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last." This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He is the First. He is the Last. He is the one who was. Who is. Who is to come. He is the Lord. He is the King. He is the one who touches. He is the one who calms. He is the one who speaks.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty." - Revelation 1:8


He is the Alpha. He is the Omega. He is the beginning. He is the end. He is the First. He is the Last. The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The glory is the reality. The touch is the reality. The Lord is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The vision is a shadow. The face of Jesus is the substance. The glory is the reality. The touch is the reality. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you need a touch? Do you need a word? Do you need someone to say, "Do not be afraid"? The Son of Man touched John. He spoke to John. He calms you. He touches you. He says, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last." He is here. He is with you. You are not alone. He is the Lord.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the First and the Last. You are the Alpha and the Omega. Touch me. Calm me. Speak to me. Do not let me be afraid. You are here. You are with me. You are the Lord. I worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: The Angel in the Book of Revelation

pages.body:
The Hook


We looked at the fire on Day 07. But there is more. The king did not just see four men. He saw the fourth man. And the fourth man was not a normal man. He was the Visitor. He was the pre-incarnate Christ. He was in the fire. With His people. And the fire did not touch them. This is one of the most dramatic encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"He said, 'Look, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they are not hurt, and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.'" - Daniel 3:25


The fourth man. Walking. In the fire. Not burned. Not hurt. The king was amazed. He did not know who it was. But he knew it was not normal. It was a god. It was the son of the gods. It was the Visitor. The one who shows up. The one who stays. The one who walks through fire. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He was in the fire. He was with His people. He was protecting them. He was present.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus said this to His disciples. He did not say, "I will keep you out of trouble." He said, "I am with you always." The fourth man in the fire is a promise. I will be with you. In the fire. In the trouble. In the pain. I will not leave. This is the heart of God. This is the Visitor. This is Jesus.


The Verdict


The fourth man is a shadow. The presence of Jesus is the substance. He is with us in the fire. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Are you in a fire? Are you in the flames? You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you. He is not going to pull you out every time. But He will be with you in it. He will not leave you. You are safe. Not because the fire is gone. Because He is there.


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for being the fourth man. Thank you for walking with me in the fire. Thank you that I am not alone. I will not be burned. I will come out. You are with me. I am safe. Amen.
pages.title: Day 28: The Angel in the Fiery Furnace

pages.body:
The Hook


Mary was a young woman. She was engaged to Joseph. She was from Nazareth. A small town. A nobody town. And an angel appeared to her. And told her she was favored. She was chosen. She would have a son. The Son of God. The Savior. This is one of the most famous encounters in the Bible.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"The angel went to her and said, 'Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.'" - Luke 1:28


The angel came to Mary. He called her favored. He called her chosen. He told her she would have a son. The Son of God. The Savior. This is the pre-incarnate Christ. He comes to the humble. He comes to the lowly. He comes to the young. He comes to the nobody. He calls them favored. He calls them chosen. He gives them a son. He gives them the Savior.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He gave her a son. The son was Jesus. The angel to Mary is a shadow. The birth of Jesus is the substance. The favor is the reality. The son is the reality. The Savior is the reality. The substance is Jesus.


The Verdict


The angel is a shadow. The Christ is the substance. He comes to the humble. He gives the Savior. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


Do you feel like a nobody? Do you feel like you are from a nowhere town? Do you feel like you are not important? The angel came to Mary. A nobody. From a nowhere town. God comes to you. You are favored. You are chosen. You are not a nobody. You are a somebody. You are His. He has a plan for you.


The Prayer


God, I feel like a nobody. I feel like I am from a nowhere town. But you came to Mary. You come to me. I am favored. I am chosen. I am yours. Thank you. Thank you for the favor. Thank you for the plan. Thank you for the Savior. I am ready. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: The Angel to Mary

pages.body:
The Hook


The ultimate encounter is not a bush. It is not a ladder. It is not a fire. It is not a whirlwind. The ultimate encounter is God in a body. The Word in flesh. The invisible in a person. The eternal in a baby. This is the encounter that all the others were pointing to. This is Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6


A child. A son. Mighty God. Everlasting Father. Prince of Peace. This is the ultimate encounter. The child is God. The son is eternal. The baby is the Creator. This is the encounter that all the other encounters were pointing to. The bush. The ladder. The tent. The fire. The whirlwind. The hand. The rock. The angel. The star. All of them. All pointing to this. The child. The son. The Savior.


The Fulfillment (NT)


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The Word became flesh. The encounter became a person. The shadow became substance. The picture became reality. The bush became a body. The ladder became a life. The tent became a person. The fire became a friend. The whirlwind became a whisper. The hand became a healer. The rock became a Savior. The angel became a brother. The star became the King. The ultimate encounter is Jesus. And He is here. He is with us. He is not far. He is near. He is the one your heart is looking for.


The Verdict


All the encounters are shadows. Jesus is the substance. All the encounters point to Him. All the encounters are fulfilled in Him. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance


You have been looking for an encounter. You have been searching for God. He is not far. He is not hiding. He has been showing up all along. In the garden. In the tent. In the fire. In the whisper. In the child. In the star. In the angel. In the risen Lord. He is the one your heart is looking for. Stop searching in the wrong places. Stop looking for Him in the stars, in the universe, in the vague force. Look at Jesus. He is the ultimate encounter. He is the one who shows up. Open your eyes. Open your heart. He is here.


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the ultimate encounter. You are the one I have been looking for. You are the one my heart has been searching for. I found you. Or rather, you found me. Thank you. Thank you for showing up. Thank you for the garden. Thank you for the tent. Thank you for the fire. Thank you for the whisper. Thank you for the child. Thank you for the star. Thank you for the risen Lord. Thank you for being the Word made flesh. Thank you for being the visible God. Thank you for being Jesus. I receive you. I believe in you. I follow you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Encounter Challenge


You have journeyed through 30 divine encounters. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up. It shows you the ultimate encounter. It shows you the Word made flesh. It shows you Jesus, the visible God. As you read, look for the encounters. Look for the moments where people meet Jesus. Look for the ones who see Him. Look for the ones who believe. And then ask yourself, "Have I encountered Him?" He is not far. He is in the book. He is in the room. He is here.


A Note on Faith


The encounters are evidence. They are evidence of a God who shows up. They are evidence of a God who is not distant. They are evidence of a God who wants to be known. But evidence does not save you. The encounters point to a person. The encounters point to Jesus. You can study the encounters and still miss the Encounter. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The encounters are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice. He is knocking. Will you open?
